meta.description: Registry for transport leakage, closure loss, and recurrence-basin failure modes in Phase 3.

failure_modes.name: transport_closure_loss
failure_modes.description: Transport maps a state to a locus outside the declared admissible domain.

failure_modes.name: transport_leakage
failure_modes.description: Incremental drift during transport iteration results in cumulative admissibility loss.

failure_modes.name: nonlocal_transport_divergence
failure_modes.description: The length or complexity of nonlocal transport paths grows without bound.

failure_modes.name: orientation_drift_escape
failure_modes.description: Orientation frame deviation exceeds the threshold for coherent transport mapping.

failure_modes.name: residue_transport_instability
failure_modes.description: Residue update dynamics during transport cycles destabilize target selection.

failure_modes.name: recurrence_basin_escape
failure_modes.description: Recursive transport maps a state outside of its established stable recurrence basin.

failure_modes.name: CSI_distance_unbounded
failure_modes.description: The causal sphere of influence radius expands indefinitely, violating boundedness.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_graph_disconnect
failure_modes.description: Transport fails because the target locus is unreachable via admissible transitions.

failure_modes.name: transport_metric_undefined
failure_modes.description: Closure cannot be analyzed due to missing or unresolved distance metrics.

failure_modes.name: false_transport_closure
failure_modes.description: System is declared closed when unmapped leakage or boundary drift exists.
